Subject: Exec preview request — tight CTO window; VP standby

Hi Alex / Morgan,

Thanks again for taking the time to explore Redwood Inference. We’d love to run an exec-level preview focused on the CTO use-cases you flagged (low-latency inference, private deployment options, and mission-critical reliability). We know Daniel’s calendar is tight — would a condensed 30-minute preview work if we keep it extremely focused on architecture and migration risk?

Proposed slot: Tue Mar 29, 1:00–1:30pm PT (we can move to 1:15pm start if that helps align). Goal: 20 minutes of demo + 10 minutes Q&A.

Two asks from our side:
- If Daniel can only do a shorter window, can a VP-level sponsor join as standby to cover the broader product/contract questions?
- Any special non-disclosure or procurement pointers we should prep for ahead of the preview?

I’ve attached a short run_of_show_v1.pdf with timing and suggested talking points. If the slot above won’t work, please propose a tight 30-min window — we’ll adapt.

Thanks,

Ben / Marissa — quick heads-up and action items.

Context: Riverline’s CTO (Daniel Lee) can do 1:15–1:45pm PT on Mar 29. This is a short window — we must be disciplined. Alex requested private deployment + latency-focused demo and asked for NDA/SOC2 artifacts prior to the preview.

Can you take these?

- Marissa: can you tighten the CTO slide deck to 12 minutes: 3 slides on architecture, 2 slides on latency benchmarks (real-world), 1 slide on migration plan. Also produce a 1-page appendix with where we host SOC2 summary and a link to the compliance pack.

I’ll send the NDA and calendar invite to Alex after I confirm we have the SOC2 summary link ready.

Thanks — want to lock this in within the hour if possible.
